heading.en: Too much data for a spreadsheet

hook.en: Every minute, people upload hundreds of hours of video and send millions of messages. No ordinary database can hold or process this. What do we call such data?
hook.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ನಿಮಿಷ ಜನರು ನೂರಾರು ಗಂಟೆಗಳ ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಸಂದೇಶ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ ಇದನ್ನು ನಿಭಾಯಿಸಲಾರದು. ಇಂತಹ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಏನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ?

objectives.en: Explain the five characteristics of big data

narration.en: Every minute, people upload hundreds of hours of video and send millions of messages. No ordinary database can hold or process this. What do we call such data?
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ನಿಮಿಷ ಜನರು ನೂರಾರು ಗಂಟೆಗಳ ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಸಂದೇಶ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ ಇದನ್ನು ನಿಭಾಯಿಸಲಾರದು. ಇಂತಹ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಏನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ?

body.en: Big data is a collection of data so large and complex that traditional data-processing tools cannot store or analyse it efficiently. It is described by five characteristics. Volume is its enormous size. Velocity is the speed at which it is generated and must be processed. Variety means it comes in many forms: structured tables, and unstructured text, images, audio and video. Veracity is about its trustworthiness, since big data may contain errors, noise and fakes. Value is the useful insight that can be extracted from it.

narration.en: Big data is a collection of data so large and complex that traditional data-processing tools cannot store or analyse it efficiently. It is described by five characteristics. Volume is its enormous size. Velocity is the speed at which it is generated and must be processed. Variety means it comes in many forms: structured tables, and unstructured text, images, audio and video. Veracity is about its trustworthiness, since big data may contain errors, noise and fakes. Value is the useful insight that can be extracted from it.
narration.kn: ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ಉಪಕರಣಗಳು ನಿಭಾಯಿಸಲಾರದಷ್ಟು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಕೀರ್ಣ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವೇ ಬೃಹತ್ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ. ಅದರ ಐದು ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು: ಗಾತ್ರ (Volume), ವೇಗ (Velocity), ವೈವಿಧ್ಯ (Variety), ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹತೆ (Veracity) ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯ (Value).

body.en: Data analytics is the process of examining data sets to find patterns and draw conclusions, using specialised software. Businesses use it to understand customers and predict demand, hospitals to spot disease outbreaks, and cricket teams to plan strategies from match data.

narration.en: Data analytics is the process of examining data sets to find patterns and draw conclusions, using specialised software. Businesses use it to understand customers and predict demand, hospitals to spot disease outbreaks, and cricket teams to plan strategies from match data.
narration.kn: ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ ಎಂದರೆ ದತ್ತಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿನ ಮಾದರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ ತೀರ್ಮಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ. ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ, ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ, ಕ್ರೀಡೆ ಮುಂತಾದ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A railway app logs ticket bookings, live train positions, passenger feedback text and station CCTV video. Match each feature to a "V" of big data: (a) crores of records (b) live positions every few seconds (c) text, numbers and video together (d) some feedback is fake.

steps.en: (a) the sheer size of the data is Volume.
(b) data arriving continuously and fast is Velocity.
(d) doubtful accuracy is a Veracity problem.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A railway app logs ticket bookings, live train positions, passenger feedback text and station CCTV video. body.en: Big data is described by five words that start with V. Say them in order of size, speed, kinds, truth and worth.
